synopsis: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3:2021 defines test-documentation structures for test plans, designs, cases and completion reports, consistently described in Chapter 9 and the glossary [f7112, f15348]. Chapter 9 places Part 3 and Part 4 within generic software and systems testing and states that neither contains collision-avoidance content [f7114]. The glossary confirms that limitation while identifying their value as discipline for separating test processes, techniques and documentation, rather than collision-avoidance-specific guidance [f15350].

relations.note: Both describe Part 3's documentation coverage: plans, designs, cases and completion reports.
Both state that Parts 3 and 4 contain no collision-avoidance content.
Glossary adds methodological value despite the absence of collision-avoidance content.
Defined documentation structures support the glossary's claim of documentation discipline.
